recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞明顯變大，核染色質呈細緻開放的篩網狀（megaloblastic chromatin），細胞質已見血紅素化但核仍不成熟（核質發育不同步），並可見大型骨髓系細胞。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with finely dispersed, open sieve-like chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: polychromatic cytoplasm with immature-appearing nuclei
Deeply basophilic early megaloblasts with abundant cytoplasm
Large granulocytic precursors with open chromatin; eosinophil myelocyte present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with megaloblastic change. Erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely dispersed, open chromatin that persists into polychromatic stages, producing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, and some show nuclear irregularity. Granulocytic precursors are also enlarged. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, in this clinical context attributable to the antifolate drug pyrimethamine.

ddx.vs: MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroids with additional multilineage dysplasia (pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes, ring sideroblasts) and normal B12/folate.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥30% proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, not a full spectrum of maturing megaloblasts.
CDA features prominent binucleation, internuclear bridges and characteristic EM findings without drug or vitamin deficiency history.
